zh-CN: 归档工作台的扫描与入库操作恢复为两行右对齐，窗口变化时不再挤压、错位或被截断。
仓库活跃度固定显示最近 20 周与固定列距；仅在空间不足时横向滚动，并默认保持最新日期可见。
优化详情按钮间距、收纳设置引导和完成烟花；手动库存备注改为选填并移除冗余说明。
MCP 仓库概览默认返回紧凑汇总，仅在明确请求时提供非空活动日期。
en-US: Workbench scan and intake actions return to two right-aligned rows without overlap, misalignment or clipping.
Warehouse activity uses a fixed 20-week layout and fixed gaps, scrolling only when needed while keeping the newest dates visible by default.
Detail-button spacing, settings onboarding and completion fireworks are improved; manual inventory notes are now optional and redundant help copy is removed.
MCP warehouse insights return a compact summary by default and provide non-empty activity dates only when explicitly requested.
